entries.title: Existing Brown measurements
entries.reason: The earlier README and plot script describe nominal units. This search did not recover the exact conversion and processing chain for the released single-drone components. Failed repository accesses leave metadata unverified.
entries.missing: Exact release → calibrated components → signed axes → normalization → masks and section stitching.

entries.title: Cene: a different drone
entries.reason: The accessible paper studies a small drone with ducted rotors in a rectangular layout. Its still-air signed vertical-component plane is near the rotors; longer sections show speed magnitude. The inspected listing contains a paper, not verified component arrays.
entries.missing: Compatible geometry and downstream signed-component files with traceable calibration and license.

entries.title: Hackett: water beneath a drone
entries.reason: This release documents water circulation stirred by a hovering drone. Water velocity cannot substitute for the airborne wake components we need.
entries.missing: Air velocity measurements in the model’s applicable geometry and domain.

entries.title: Hundur: flight logs and calculations
entries.reason: The repository describes flight-controller logs and processed computational-flow tables. These are not independent experimental measurements of the wake components.
entries.missing: Measured signed air velocities, with locations, units and uncertainty.

limitation: Bounded search; no claim that suitable data do not exist. Prior results unchanged.
